sql: select count(*) from approval_queue where block = 'ceo' and object_type = 'weekly_board' and object_id = 'board:2026-W46' and created_by = 'agent:da_pmo' and status = 'pending' and position('## Mốc trễ' in payload) > 0 and position('## Mốc chưa có ngày' in payload) > 0
select string_agg(code, ',' order by due_date, code) from project_milestones where due_date < '2026-11-10' and status <> 'xong'

select count(*) from project_milestones m where m.due_date < '2026-11-10' and m.status <> 'xong' and not exists (select 1 from approval_queue q where q.object_type = 'weekly_board' and q.status = 'pending' and position('- **TRỄ** ' || m.code || ' —' in q.payload) > 0)

select count(*) from project_milestones m where (m.due_date >= '2026-11-10' or m.status = 'xong') and exists (select 1 from approval_queue q where q.object_type = 'weekly_board' and q.status = 'pending' and position('- **TRỄ** ' || m.code || ' —' in q.payload) > 0)
